mechanism: Ketorolac (NSAID) increases GI bleeding risk and reduces renal blood flow, while mefloquine causes neuropsychiatric effects and GI disturbances; combined use elevates gastrointestinal adverse events and potential renal impairment.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use ketorolac at lowest effective dose for shortest duration with gastroprotection (PPI), monitor renal function, and consider alternative analgesics.
